title: MuxedAccount accepts an ID of 2^64 and encodes ID 0
severity_basis: Encode side only: a caller that passes an out-of-range ID gets a valid address for a different ID (0). Decoding of ledger data is not affected. No reader impact verified.

entries.expected: reject: 18446744073709551616 is outside the unsigned 64-bit range
entries.observed: ok: an M address whose ID is 0

evidence.pre_fix: stellar-sdk 17.0.1 from PyPI, probe vector 2m3: outcome ok, encoded ID 0. Same on 17.0.0.
evidence.expected_basis: MuxedAccount.med25519.id is an unsigned 64-bit integer in the XDR definitions (stellar-xdr v30.0). js-stellar-sdk rejects the same input since 17.3.0 (PR #1780).

reproduction.method: Independent re-execution in the matrix probe after the first observation in the Python and Java defect-surface probe

issue_draft.dry_run_command: gh issue create --repo StellarCN/py-stellar-base --title "MuxedAccount accepts an ID of 2^64 and encodes ID 0" --body-file findings/F-0009/issue-py-stellar-base.md

history.note: Created from the matrix probe row for vector 2m3.
